content: {"episode_id":"ep-05028","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry, for this episode. The clinical indication note documents a patient presenting with recurrent palpitations and a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, raising concern for undiagnosed paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as a potential embolic source, consistent with diagnosis codes G45.9, I48.91, and R00.2. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. As the note states, this study aims to guide anticoagulation therapy and rate control management based on the burden of atrial fibrillation detected, and we ask that the service be reviewed as medically necessary."}
